court_name: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
petitioner: Giri Textiles, through Proprietor Chandrayya R. Pasnuri
respondent: Anthony Nadar and Jainam Silk Mills
government_department_involved: Labour Court, Thane and Industrial Court, Thane

directives.text: Register the High Court order in the relevant case file.
Forward the High Court's order to the Labour Court, Thane for further proceedings in Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014.
Ensure the Labour Court, Thane initiates proceedings for Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014, as directed by the High Court.
directives.deadline_text: Within 6 months from receipt of order

directives.text: The Labour Court, Thane to decide Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 on its merits, without being influenced by previous observations, except for the concluded issue.
directives.deadline_text: Within 6 months from receipt of order

directives.text: Monitor the progress of Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 to ensure it is decided within the stipulated six-month period.

raw_summary: The High Court dismissed the writ petition, upholding the orders of the Labour Court and Industrial Court. The court held that the objection regarding non-maintainability of the application due to alleged non-compliance with Section 42(4) of the Maharashtra Industrial Relations Act, 1946, did not merit acceptance. The Labour Court was directed to proceed with Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 and decide it on merits preferably within six months.
